purpose: Author worked cases for independent review. No actual factory data, numerical defaults, scientific approval or exhaustive validation claim.

cases.counterexample: 330 kg counts opening FG and returns again; 120 kg counts closing FG twice.
cases.scope: One unique newly accepted cohort; dispatch and closing FG disjoint.

cases.counterexample: 0.8 MJ/kg drops opening-WIP inherited burden; 1.2 MJ/kg adds it twice.
cases.scope: Opening WIP entering new acceptance carries its actual prior vector once.

cases.counterexample: 20/100 incorrectly charges unrelated new product; 30 kg returned is not a new denominator.
cases.scope: Return/retest increment stays on original cohort; unknown original denominator remains unresolved.

cases.expected: No finite per-kg product inventory. Retain 25 MJ unnormalized on stock/cohort or unresolved activity ledger.
cases.counterexample: Reporting 0 MJ/kg or silently dropping a failed charge creates a false zero.
1200*(1-0.5)=600 kg incorrectly treats dry-basis moisture as wet-basis fraction.
cases.scope: Untreated wood with measured dry-basis water ratio only.

cases.counterexample: 300 kg assigns retained preservative mass to water; oven loss cannot establish water when volatile chemicals are unknown.
cases.scope: Independent dry-wood and non-water-chemical constraints; no invented water residual with other unknowns.

cases.counterexample: Adding 60 kg analytical components and 40 kg carrier again gives 250 kg; buying oxides separately is a different route.
cases.scope: Illustrative verified composition only; 60% is a synthetic test input, not SDS content or a PCR recipe.

cases.counterexample: 140 kg duplicates carrier water as an additional physical purchase.
cases.scope: Nested water subledger, not a third external inventory input.

cases.counterexample: 1 kg CuO is not 1 kg Cu; oxide equivalent does not establish dissolved molecular species.
cases.scope: Rounded illustrative atomic weights; actual data require documented weights, purity and analytical basis.

cases.counterexample: 0.52 kg total Cr does not establish a CrIII/CrVI environmental split.
cases.scope: Rounded illustrative atomic weights; no oxidation-state yield or numerical PCR factor.

cases.counterexample: Using one As atom in the numerator halves the elemental mass; assigning AsIII/AsV is ungrounded.
cases.scope: Rounded illustrative atomic weights, not an adopted numerical factor.

cases.formula: known retained amount in assay zone = 10*0.02
cases.counterexample: 10*0.1 = 1 kg silently applies sapwood-zone retention to unsampled heartwood; whole-pole total remains unknown.
cases.scope: Only the measured representative zone, not a whole-piece recipe.

cases.counterexample: 1+0.7+0.2=1.9 kg double-counts nested cumulative measurements; incompatible tests or a negative residual require review.
cases.scope: Same source, interval, sampling and analytical basis; metal content remains a speciation subledger.

cases.counterexample: 600 kg relabels mg as kg; 0.0002 kg omits the 3-hour integration; multiplying an already integrated 300 m3 by 3 hours duplicates time.
cases.scope: Compatible concentration, volume, duration and actual post-control source.

cases.counterexample: Calling the first borrowed 8 kg a return ER invents a prior outward item; omitting it because no invoice breaks physical custody balance.
cases.scope: Each article/cohort; genuine ER requires that same item earlier outward S. Unknown inherited burden is not zero.

cases.counterexample: Physical wood stays 100 kg and bark 20 kg; multiplying these by 0.7 breaks mass balance. Treatment dedicated to wood is not assigned to bark removed earlier.
cases.scope: A acts on justified residual burden after subdivision and exchange-specific causal attribution, never gross physical V.

cases.counterexample: 0.2 kg unexplained Cu cannot be arbitrarily assigned between air, water and sludge, or treated as CuO mass. The gross wet liquor waste already contains its Cu.
cases.scope: Independent element ledger with uncertainty; missing destinations remain unresolved.
